Summary: 7 targets · 12 grants · 1 example

Legend:
  route / via   direct = entry point directly to Cloud Run / Agent Runtime; apigee = Apigee gateway;
                agent_gateway = outbound Central Agent Gateway (mismatch shows gateway != ingress)
  identity      workload (agent) = agent's own Agent Identity; non-agent: service_account, group,
                apigee_app, federated (OIDC), spiffe
  pays          calling team / cost centers this caller may declare
  policy        unmapped_caller=deny|flag (guard action on unknown caller);
                declared_mismatch=reject|bill_own_team (foreign cost center handling)
  badges        [enforced] compiled into IAM/gateway; [declared only] not enforced;
                [example] [not compiled] skipped from enforcement; [adopted from <src>] pinned entry
